messages:
alex: Heads-up — Customer 4521 says p95/p99 lines are missing from the latency dashboard after the cutover a few mins ago. https://tickets.internal/4521 :eyes:

sre-bot: Deploy finished: telemetry-collector v2.7.0 to prod-canary (deploy id d-2024-11-12-07).

jess: I can repro on the prod dashboard — p50 and p75 render, but p95/p99 are flat/not present. Screenshot attached in the ticket.

maria: Quick check — can you paste the Grafana panel's PromQL? I want to see if it's a query problem vs upstream metrics changed.

jess: Panel uses: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))
```
It's the same query we've used for months.

samir: I looked at collector logs around the canary flip — there's a warning about relabeling: 
```
WARN  [2024-11-12T07:02:14Z] relabel: renamed label 'le' -> 'bucket' (config change: telemetry-collector PR #1234)
```
That seems suspicious. If buckets got renamed the histogram_quantile would break.

alex: @samir can you grep Prom for the raw series? If the buckets names changed, we should see bucket series with label 'bucket' instead of 'le'.

samir: quick grep output: 
```
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="api",bucket="0.1"} 1234
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="api",bucket="0.5"} 2345

# old form (not present): redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="api",le="0.1"} 
```
so yep, buckets have been relabeled.

customer-support: Customer 4521 says their SLO page displays blanks now and they got an alert for p95 breach. They're asking for ETA.

maria: Root cause confirmed: collector relabels changed 'le' -> 'bucket' in PR #1234 during the canary. PromQL histogram_quantile expects the bucket boundary label to be named `le` (by convention). Grafana queries therefore return nothing for p95/p99.

jess: Proposed immediate fix: revert relabeling on canary (rollback) or add a recording rule that maps bucket->le as temporary shim. Which do we want?

samir: Rollback started (canary). Watching metrics and restarting collector pods.

# After rollback
samir: Collector rollback complete, pods restarted. Prom shows series back with `le` labels: 
```
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="api",le="0.1"} 1300
```

jess: Grafana dashboard refreshed — p95/p99 lines returned. Customer confirmed. :tada:

alex: Great. Please add a postmortem + a CI dashboard assertion so future relabel changes fail fast.

maria: Filing follow-up issue: https://issues.internal/RED-telemetry-89 -> add integration tests + require canary check that p95 panel renders.

jess: Closing ticket 4521 (customer notified). Also adding a note to the deploy checklist to not change histogram label keys without a compatibility shim.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-4521 (severity: high); linked PRs: #1234, #1236 (rollback).

alex: thanks all — assign me the postmortem and I'll draft root-cause + corrective actions.

customer-support: Customer 4521 updated: they have SLO visibility again and ask to be pinged once the postmortem is done.

jess: Will do.
